chapters.title: Mileage and per diem expense configuration

features.name: Expense Agent
features.description: An agent in Business Central that handles expense submission, approval, and processing. Activated from the role center avatar.

features.name: Access and submission configuration
features.description: Controls how external expense users can submit expenses via web app or email. Allows configuration of M365 email account and access permissions.
caveats: Email account is typically a shared mailbox

features.name: Expense user registration
features.description: Allows adding employees to the expense user list. Can add individual employees, all employees, or import from M365 graph.

features.name: Default approver configuration
features.description: Setting up a person who can approve all expenses, with option for more granular approver setup on a different page.

features.name: Number series configuration
features.description: Allows admin to insert number series for accounting defaults, with preview capability and smart detection to skip existing series.
caveats: If number series already exists, insertion is skipped

features.name: Payment method defaults
features.description: Recommends default payment methods such as bank with reimbursement type company paid.

features.name: Posting group defaults
features.description: Suggests default posting groups with preview capability to see what records will be inserted.

features.name: Expense categories
features.description: Suggests new categories for expense classification with preview capability.

features.name: Management defaults and rules
features.description: Defines expense locations and management rules with auto-selection when system detects no existing data.

features.name: Rules and controls enforcement
features.description: Allows selection to enforce management rules, anti-corruption attestation display, and receipt number or merchant name requirements.

features.name: Email notification configuration
features.description: Specifies email account for sending notifications to end users, with options for outbox or no-reply accounts and different notification types.
caveats: Email account must be configured before auto-population works

features.name: Approval notifications
features.description: Controls whether to notify end users of approval updates.

features.name: Mileage expense configuration
features.description: Configures mileage expense calculation based on rate per unit and unit of measure.

features.name: Project tracking for expenses
features.description: Allows expense users to track expenses against specific projects with visibility controls for assigned or all projects.
caveats: Visibility can be limited to assigned projects only

features.name: Per diem expense configuration
features.description: Defines per diem calculation rules with options for detailed rule specifications and reduction application.

features.name: Welcome email to expense users
features.description: Sends welcome email to selected expense users with details for using the expense web app portal or email receipt submission.

quotes.text: Welcome to the Expense Agent setup video. Today, I will show you how to configure the Expense Agent in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that this is a configuration guide for the Expense Agent, a new agent in Business Central.

quotes.text: I have the option to add all my employees or existing employees to the expense user list, or I can also import expense user
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows flexibility in how expense users can be onboarded, including M365 integration.

quotes.text: We have added this option to make it easier for the Expense Agent admin to add one approver, but they can do more granular
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that default approver is a convenience option with more detailed approval configuration available elsewhere.

quotes.text: And system is smart enough to auto select these when it detects there are no data in the system.
quotes.why_it_matters: Documents the auto-detection and auto-selection behavior of default settings in the wizard.

quotes.text: We have also added project tracking where you can allow expense user to track an expense against a specific project.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the new capability to link expenses to projects in the 2026 release.

quotes.text: Finally, we have per diem expenses where you can define the per diem calculation rules.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies per diem as a distinct expense type with configurable calculation rules.

quotes.text: This welcome email consists of all the details they need to use the expense web app portal or where to send the expense receipts
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes what the welcome email sent to expense users after activation contains.
